title: Datopotamab–deruxtecan in early-stage breast cancer: the sequential multiple assignment randomized I-SPY2.2 phase 2 trial
comparison_or_design: The subtype-specific Dato-DXd I-SPY2.2 strategy analysis across Blocks A–C and its reported dynamic-control comparison.
observations_or_assays: Pathological complete response across the treatment strategy
Residual Cancer Burden (RCB) class distribution at surgery
time_scope: Surgery after the complete treatment strategy or protocol-directed early surgery, in the primary strategy analysis.
excluded: Block-A-only efficacy and every other subtype
preRCB-adherent sensitivities, toxicity, and the separate Dato-DXd plus durvalumab arm
population_or_material: The HR-negative/HER2-negative/Immune-negative/DRD-negative subtype in the Dato-DXd I-SPY2.2 arm.
requested_items: For the specified RPS subtype and complete treatment strategy: modeled pCR and observed pCR count/proportion; dynamic-control modeled pCR; P(>DC); and observed RCB class counts/proportions in the RCB-evaluable subset. Exclude pCR timing by treatment block, combined pCR/RCB-I summaries, alternate candidate historical regimens and sensitivity strategies.
case_specific_rules: Use Supplementary Figure 2 for the requested labelled RCB class counts. Apply the shared rules for distinct statistical targets and unlabelled values.
